rt:param.name: Grad_Style
rt:param.comment: Индикатор имеет градиентную заливку - объёмный фон

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub StatusColor() Dim FinStat As UShort FinStat = 0 'Состояние 1 If ((InUse & 1) > 0) Then If (pv1.Quality != PLS_QUAL_BAD) && (pv1.Value != 0) Then FinStat = 1 End If End If If ((InUse & 2) > 0) && (FinStat == 0) Then If (pv2.Quality != PLS_QUAL_BAD) && (pv2.Value != 0) Then FinStat = 2 End If End If If ((InUse & 4) > 0) && (FinStat == 0) Then If (pv3.Quality != PLS_QUAL_BAD) && (pv3.Value != 0) Then FinStat = 4 End If End If If ((InUse & 8) > 0) && (FinStat == 0) Then If (pv4.Quality != PLS_QUAL_BAD) && (pv4.Value != 0) Then FinStat = 8 End If End If If ((InUse & 16) > 0) && (FinStat == 0) Then If (pv5.Quality != PLS_QUAL_BAD) && (pv5.Value != 0) Then FinStat = 16 End If End If If ((InUse & 32) > 0) && (FinStat == 0) Then If (pv6.Quality != PLS_QUAL_BAD) && (pv6.Value != 0) Then FinStat = 32 End If End If If (FinStat == 0) Then main_text.text = "-" body.fill = Color_NotSel ElseIf (FinStat == 1) Then main_text.text = Text_1 body.fill = Col_1 ElseIf (FinStat == 2) Then main_text.text = Text_2 body.fill = Col_2 ElseIf (FinStat == 4) Then main_text.text = Text_3 body.fill = Col_3 ElseIf (FinStat == 8) Then main_text.text = Text_4 body.fill = Col_4 ElseIf (FinStat == 16) Then main_text.text = Text_5 body.fill = Col_5 ElseIf (FinStat == 32) Then main_text.text = Text_6 body.fill = Col_6 End If End Sub
rt:model.rt:event: If (PointID_1 != "NULL") Then pv1 = BIN(PointID_1) If (pv1 != Nothing) Then InUse = 1 End If End If If (PointID_2 != "NULL") Then pv2 = BIN(PointID_2) If (pv2 != Nothing) Then InUse = InUse | 2 End If End If If (PointID_3 != "NULL") Then pv3 = BIN(PointID_3) If (pv3 != Nothing) Then InUse = InUse | 4 End If End If If (PointID_4 != "NULL") Then pv4 = BIN(PointID_4) If (pv4 != Nothing) Then InUse = InUse | 8 End If End If If (PointID_5 != "NULL") Then pv5 = BIN(PointID_5) If (pv5 != Nothing) Then InUse = InUse | 16 End If End If If (PointID_6 != "NULL") Then pv6 = BIN(PointID_6) If (pv6 != Nothing) Then InUse = InUse | 32 End If End If

Dim MsgStr As String If (PointID_1 == "NULL") Then ShowWarning ("Объект неправильно привязан.", 0) ElseIf (PointID_1 != "NULL") && (pv1 == Nothing) Then MsgStr = "Ошибка привязки.
PointID_1 = "" + PointID_1 + """ ShowWarning (MsgStr, 0) ElseIf (PointID_2 != "NULL") && (pv2 == Nothing) Then MsgStr = "Ошибка привязки.
PointID_2 = "" + PointID_2 + """ ShowWarning (MsgStr, 0) ElseIf (PointID_3 != "NULL") && (pv3 == Nothing) Then MsgStr = "Ошибка привязки.
PointID_3 = "" + PointID_3 + """ ShowWarning (MsgStr, 0) ElseIf (PointID_4 != "NULL") && (pv4 == Nothing) Then MsgStr = "Ошибка привязки.
PointID_4 = "" + PointID_4 + """ ShowWarning (MsgStr, 0) ElseIf (PointID_5 != "NULL") && (pv5 == Nothing) Then MsgStr = "Ошибка привязки.
PointID_5 = "" + PointID_5 + """ ShowWarning (MsgStr, 0) ElseIf (PointID_6 != "NULL") && (pv6 == Nothing) Then MsgStr = "Ошибка привязки.
PointID_6 = "" + PointID_6 + """ ShowWarning (MsgStr, 0) Else Dim s As String s = PointID_1 If (PointID_2 != "NULL") Then s = s + "|" + PointID_2 End If If (PointID_3 != "NULL") Then s = s + "|" + PointID_3 End If If (PointID_4 != "NULL") Then s = s + "|" + PointID_4 End If If (PointID_5 != "NULL") Then s = s + "|" + PointID_5 End If If (PointID_6 != "NULL") Then s = s + "|" + PointID_6 End If Open_Win_Uni(False, "wi_" + PointID_1, "Составной объект " + pv1.CategoryText, "wi_MultyPV", s) End If
